description: Sustrans cycle network is a dataset listed in Open Data Bristol, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Sustrans www.betterbybike.info. National Cycle Routes, National Cycle Network links and Regional cycle Routes for the West of England (WoE) area, including attribute information such as Route number and name, Route characteristic and On road status. Coverage: Bristol. The portal files it under Transport & Streets, Leisure & Tourism, Environment. Its keywords are cycling, bike, Better By Bike. The portal shows 716 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-07-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-bristol-gov-uk-portal.
